author: August Schwerdfeger
name: transfer_hierarchy
description: Moves or copies selected images from one directory tree to another while preserving the original folder structure.
description-extensive: Normally moving or copying a batch of photos in darktable dumps them all into a single destination folder. This tool lets you transfer whole folder trees at once while keeping their original subfolder layout intact, which is ideal for shifting images from a working folder to long-term storage such as a NAS. No extra software is needed.
